description: This file defines React components for displaying and managing a list of chat sessions, including drag-and-drop reordering, chat item rendering, and interaction handling.

classes.name: ChatItem
classes.description: A React component representing a single chat session item, with drag-and-drop and delete functionality.

classes.name: ChatList
classes.description: A React component that renders a list of chat sessions with drag-and-drop reordering and delete options.

methods.name: ChatItem
methods.description: Renders a chat item with title, count, time, avatar, and delete icon, supporting selection and narrow layout.

methods.name: ChatList
methods.description: Renders a draggable list of chat sessions, allowing reordering and deletion, integrating with chat store.
